'''Gavin Palmer''' finished 4th at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec-sun">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Sunday semi-final results], Decipher (7 December 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427191534/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Internet Archive]</ref> He won the [[1997 Tatooine Regionals (Salt Lake City)]], a qualifier for that event.<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I'm 19 years-old and have been playing Star Wars CCG since February '96."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/palmer.html Gavin Palmer], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428022253/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/palmer.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I was born and raised in Durango."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"It's a small town, so I have to travel to most of the Star Wars CCG events in which I participate."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I love to downhill ski; play full contact football (the only fun way to play); and play sand volleyball."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I also enjoy weight training, drama, and Star Wars CCG."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I attend Fort Lewis College and keep a 4.0 GPA."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I work for BULA, a winter headwear company founded in Durango: BULA is one of the official sponsors of the '98 Winter Olympics."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite movies include the Star Wars trilogy, Braveheart and The Princess Bride."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite Dark Side card is There'll Be Hell to Pay."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite Light Side card is Grimtaash."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Also, I love the Tonnika Sisters."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I mean, I really love them!"<ref name="dec97bio" />
